actualResultAssessment.redAssertionReachabilityDisposition: In `simulate_header_dispatch.rs`, all 3 header error CLI invocations (`unknown`, `missing`, `commented`) along with their library `mori_core::language` Error DTOs and the 4th `empty-core2` control CLI invocation are executed and written to disk (lines 174-190) before the assertion loop begins at line 191. On RED, the first loop iteration (`unknown`) passes the producer Error DTO (offset 16), exit status 1, and empty stdout assertions (lines 193-199), then panics at line 200 on the human stderr mismatch (`Expected language "moriarty/1"; found\n  │ "other".` vs dual-profile expected stderr). Consequently, the Rust test runner never reaches the loop iterations for `missing` and `commented` or the post-loop `empty-core2` control assertions (lines 207-214) during RED; those captured RED outputs are instead verified by the separate root mechanical comparison (`FROZEN-OBSERVATION-COMPARISON.json`), while all Rust assertions are reached and pass in GREEN.
